scene_description: A first-person traversal of an apartment entry hall, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user opens and later closes two coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, an integrated refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer.
